\qquad\mathrm{(B)}\ (-1,2)
\qquad\mathrm{(C)}\ (1,-2)
\qquad\mathrm{(D)}\ (2,-1)
\qquad\mathrm{(E)}\ (4,4)$ Show that it is \mathrm{(C)}\ (1,-2).
